name: hts-precompile-demo-yarn-validation
description: Yarn validation for the HTS precompile demo: install, Hardhat compile, lint, and Next.js production build without live secrets.

commands.name: install
commands.purpose: Install the Next.js + Hardhat workspaces exactly as a scaffold-hbar Yarn repo.

commands.name: hardhat-compile
commands.purpose: Compile Solidity contracts in packages/hardhat without live credentials.

commands.name: lint
commands.purpose: Run root lint after Foundry has been stripped from scripts/workspaces.

commands.name: build
commands.purpose: Verify the generated Next.js app builds for production without live secrets.
